title: Seated Dip Machine
summary: A seated dip machine that trains the triceps and lower chest without supporting your body weight.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for triceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.6 for chest (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.4 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Sit tall and take the handles at your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Let the handles come up slowly until your elbows are bent about 90 degrees.

form_cues.cue: Stay upright for triceps. Lean forward a little for more chest.

mistakes.text: Leaning far forward and shrugging the shoulders up.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less stable, More technical.
